name: Astral Vulture's Crimson Plumage
passiveDesc: For 12s after triggering a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, ATK increases by 24%/30%/36%/42%/48%. In addition, when 1/2 or more characters in the party are of a different Elemental Type from the equipping character, the DMG dealt by the equipping character's Charged Attacks is increased by 20%/48% | 25%/60% | 30%/72% | 35%/84% | 40%/96% and Elemental Burst DMG dealt is increased by 10%/24% | 12.5%/30% | 15%/36% | 17.5%/42% | 20%/48%.
description: An ancient longbow crested with red feathers, a sacred relic of the Flower-Feather Clan that has been passed down from generation to generation.

modifiers.label: ATK Bonus for 12s after Swirl or Stellar Swirl
Charged Attack DMG Bonus with exactly 1 different-element party member
Charged Attack DMG Bonus with 2+ different-element party members (replaces the 1-member total)
Elemental Burst DMG Bonus with exactly 1 different-element party member
Elemental Burst DMG Bonus with 2+ different-element party members (replaces the 1-member total)
